pml_diagnosis.description: First diagnosis of progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy

items.rationale: The SNOMED concept 433957 'Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy' is the primary concept, and its descendants are included to ensure all relevant subtypes are captured.
The SNOMED concept 37116468 'Dementia with progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy' is included as a subtype.
The SNOMED concept 45766390 'Leukoencephalopathy with brainstem and spinal cord involvement and lactate elevation' is included as a subtype.
The SNOMED concept 37017246 'Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy co-occurrent with human immunodeficiency virus infection' is included as a subtype.
